'''Greentop Tower''' was a docking tower on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the tower was burnt down by agents of the Hutt [[Noako]] in retaliation for the destruction of Noako's [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] ''[[Blackmist]]'' at Sinasu's hand.
